gloss: to handle, to work on, to produce

definitions.gloss: to handle, to work on, to be involved in
definitions.explanation: To take on a project, business, or creative work and be personally involved in carrying it out. Often implies hands-on involvement or responsibility.
To personally raise or care for a child or young person from an early age.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいプロジェクトを{手|て}がける。
examples.english: To work on a new project.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{数|かず}{多|おお}くの{映画|えいが}を{手|て}がけた{監督|かんとく}だ。
examples.english: He is a director who has worked on numerous films.

examples.japanese: この{建築|けんちく}{事務所|じむしょ}は{国内外|こくないがい}の{大型|おおがた}プロジェクトを{手|て}がけている。
examples.english: This architecture firm handles large-scale projects both domestically and internationally.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}で{手|て}がけた{子|こ}だ。
examples.english: This is a child I raised myself.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さい{頃|ころ}から{手|て}がけた{弟子|でし}だ。
examples.english: This is a student I have trained since they were young.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}が{手|て}がけた{庭|にわ}には、{季節|きせつ}ごとに{美|うつく}しい{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く。
examples.english: The garden my grandmother tended has beautiful flowers each season.

notes:
{手|て}がける means to take something on personally and work on it with hands-on involvement. It carries a nuance of dedicated effort and personal responsibility.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロジェクトを{手|て}がける: to work on a project
- {設計|せっけい}を{手|て}がける: to handle the design
- {作品|さくひん}を{手|て}がける: to produce a work
- {事業|じぎょう}を{手|て}がける: to run a business
